$comment: Resource registry for jumbo_worker.pool. HBM figures are estimates from docs/architecture.md §4.2 until the S0 spikes profile them; hbm_ceiling is set by spike 6 (0.80 or 0.90).

magi_v2.notes: Magi v2 (ragavsachdeva/magiv2, personal/non-commercial weights): panels, texts + OCR, speakers, characters per image. Tall slices are tiled. First wake downloads ~2 GB from the HF Hub. Spike 2 profiles HBM and speed.

drama3.notes: Fish Audio Drama 3 (35B MoE, 3B active) through speech.cpp 0.8.11 built for CUDA sm_75 with the dual-GPU and memory-cap patch; weights sakasegawa/drama-3-GGUF. Setup (c), chosen by the project lead from spike 5: one Q5_K replica split over both T4s, later layers' experts on CUDA1, 8 of 40 layers' experts on the CPU. Spike 5 at a 0.8 cap: peak 11.5 / 10.5 GiB on the two cards, 8.3 GB RAM, load 104 s, 1.22 s per second of audio. 44.1 kHz. speech.cpp sizes its share from the cards' free memory, so it reserves 10 GiB a card here: whisper loads first (pipeline/voice/stage.py) and Drama 3 fills what is left under the cap (2026-10-31 run 2: 11.0 / 8.4 GiB beside whisper's 2.0 on card 1, 1.47 s per second of audio). On a TPU host it does not run yet (no ggml TPU backend; TorchTPU is the path to test).

whisper.notes: Whisper large-v3 through faster-whisper (CTranslate2, not ggml: the backend only names a fallback runner), int8 on the host CPU: hears each voice take so the voice job can cut it to its line and speak it again when words are missing. Off the T4s since 2026-11-03: on long lines Drama 3 grew to 11 GiB on card 1 and the two no longer fit under the ceiling. No cores leased (Drama 3 holds the host's); it runs two threads beside it. First wake installs faster-whisper and downloads ~3 GB from the HF Hub.

qwen3vl_32b.notes: The Director on Kaggle's T4 x2 (Method 1, spike 7e): Qwen3-VL-32B Instruct Q6_K + F16 vision projector through llama.cpp b11925 (jumbo-llamacpp-cuda75), split by layer over both cards, 16K context, q8_0 KV cache. Spike 7e: 14.4 GiB on each card (96%), so it runs alone, past the ceiling, by the project lead's exception. First wake downloads 28 GB in ~140 s, then loads in ~130 s; ~6 tokens/s, 8-10 min per scene.

qwen3vl_32b_tpu.notes: The Director on a TPU: Qwen3-VL-32B Instruct bf16 (66.7 GB), TP=8 on vLLM-TPU, only on the project lead's command (ADR 0004/0005). vLLM fills each chip to gpu_memory_utilization (= hbm_ceiling). Not yet run: TPU run 1 timed out compiling. On the T4s the Director is the llama.cpp runner (models/qwen3vl.py).

librarian.notes: Memory-R2 7B or the Qwen2.5-7B fallback, guided MemoryDelta output. Spike 4.

remotion.notes: One chapter render per replica. Throughput from spike 5.
